educationalGoal: In this course, students will understand the following: 1. role of licensed psychologists, 2. legal obligations and ethics of licensed psychologists, 3. ensuring the safety of those who need psychological support, 4. appropriate handling of information, 5. specific tasks of licensed psychologists in health care, welfare, education, and other fields, 6. advice: In the course, students will learn to take initiative about the items 1-8 listed in the learning objectives above. In this lecture, students will learn about the background and legal position of the national qualification of licensed psychologist, and the roles and legal obligations of licensed psychologists. This lecture will take the form of multiple lecturers explaining each area.
requiredKnowledge:
This course is required to obtain the national certification as a licensed psychologist.
Students must have completed all courses for licensed psychologists offered by the third year.

              学習・教育目標

              1.Role of Licensed Psychologists
2.Legal Obligations and Ethics of Licensed Psychologists
3.Ability to identify and solve own problems
4.Preparation for lifelong learning
5.Multi-professional collaboration and community collaboration

              In this course, students will understand the following: 1. role of licensed psychologists, 2. legal obligations and ethics of licensed psychologists, 3. ensuring the safety of those who need psychological support, 4. appropriate handling of information, 5. specific tasks of licensed psychologists in health care, welfare, education, and other fields, 6. Ability to find and solve problems, 7 Preparation for lifelong learning, 8 Multi-professional collaboration and community collaboration.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              In the course, students will learn to take initiative about the items 1-8 listed in the learning objectives above. In this lecture, students will learn about the background and legal position of the national qualification of licensed psychologist, and the roles and legal obligations of licensed psychologists. This lecture will take the form of multiple lecturers explaining each area.

              教科書および参考書・リザーブドブック

              Professionalism of Licensed Psychologists

              履修に必要な予備知識や技能

              This course is required to obtain the national certification as a licensed psychologist.
Students must have completed all courses for licensed psychologists offered by the third year.
